row.notes: New row. ValGenesis sells a GxP validation lifecycle platform (iVal, iClean, iOps, iCMC, iCPV) to life-sciences companies by quote only. A ValGenesis article mentions an Active Directory interface and an SSO option for iVal, but no SSO, SCIM or user-API documentation is public and there is no help centre or developer site. Not in Okta's catalogue or the Entra tutorial index. Status unknown because product docs are not public.
